panels.title: Финансовая сводка по месяцам
panels.description: Столбец — календарный месяц, строки — выручка, аренда и валовая прибыль.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.price), 0) AS revenue,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.rent_debt), 0) AS rent,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.price - s.rent_debt), 0) AS gross_profit
FROM main.schedule s
LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id = s.type_train_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.date::timestamp)
  AND COALESCE(s.is_group, false)::text ~ '^(${format:regex})$'
  AND COALESCE(t.location, 'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Отработано часов по месяцам
panels.description: Каждый слот в расписании считается одним отработанным часом.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       COUNT(s.id) AS worked_hours
FROM main.schedule s
LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id = s.type_train_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.date::timestamp)
  AND COALESCE(s.is_group, false)::text ~ '^(${format:regex})$'
  AND COALESCE(t.location, 'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
